description: COSMO11 is an 11 GHz total-power radiometer/polarimeter on the COSMOSOMAS experiment at Teide Observatory, mapping Galactic diffuse emission and CMB foregrounds in two channels.
facility_description: Teide Observatory (Observatorio del Teide) is an astronomical observatory located on Mount Teide in Tenerife, Canary Islands, operated by the Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias (IAC).
notes: COSMO11 uses two orthogonal linear-polarisation total-power channels with matched square-law (direct) detectors and a 2 GHz bandwidth (Hildebrandt et al. 2007, whose Fig. 3 shows the receiver response).

Ch1.Description: COSMO11 channel 1 (North-South linear polarisation; mean weighted frequency 10.89 GHz)

Ch2.Description: COSMO11 channel 2 (East-West linear polarisation; mean weighted frequency 10.87 GHz)
